## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.12 — Preset hover, wrapping strip, and a filter that remembers

> **Alpha.** Four more fixes from daily use: preset chips now pop on hover
> instead of losing their tint, the all-lights tile is borderless, the
> entertainment-scenes strip wraps instead of overflowing, and the lights
> filter survives cold starts and bookmarks.

### Preset chips pop on hover

Hovering a preset no longer cancels its color — the tint's hue gets an HSV
saturation boost and applies to the background and the border, so the chip
brightens into itself rather than greying out.

### All-lights tile is borderless

The global aggregate tile matches the room tile: no border, no hover raise.
Both read as summary rows; the lamps keep the outlines.

### Scenes strip wraps

The entertainment-zone presets strip wraps into rows inside the main
container. No horizontal scroll, no right-edge overflow.

### The lights filter survives restarts and bookmarks

The filter choice now persists in localStorage per device and is restored on
a cold start through the shell. Direct bookmarks work too:
`/lights.html?filter=all` (and `?filter=room&room=<id>`) survives the
standalone redirect and opens with that filter applied — the URL still wins
when both exist.
